newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX says trade volume second highest in 1996.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX says trade volume second highest in 1996.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange said Thursday that trading activity hit the second highest volume in its history, with about 75.80 million contracts changing hands last year.
Volume in 1995, including the COMEX division, totaled about 73.47 million, NYMEX said in a statement.
NYMEX and COMEX merged their operations in 1994.
NYMEX said the highest annual volume record was set in 1994, when 78.66 million contracts traded.

NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures set a record of about 8.81 milllion contracts in 1996 from about 8.09 million contracts in 1995, while Henry Hub options hit a record of about 1.23 million contracts from about 920,000 contracts in 1995.
